name: argo-database-manager
description: For the ARGO database manager. See what requests are outstanding across the core tracking REDCaps, then fulfil them: build a study's REDCap from a submitted request (build-study), add people and manage access (manage-redcaps), get data out as files (export-data), and match records across studies with safe fill-blanks-only write-back (link-data). Works with or without an access key.
